description.zh: 坐席账号名称，实例内唯一（登录名）
description.en: The name of the agent account, which must be unique within the instance (logon name).

description.zh: 客户请求唯一id，用于幂等校验，可以用uuid生成
description.en: The unique ID of the client request. This parameter is used for idempotence verification. You can use a UUID to generate the value.

description.zh:
修改到的状态类型
 
- requestRest   （申请小休）
- requestLogout  （申请离线）
- restToWork  （小休转上班）
description.en:
The target status type. Valid values:
 
- requestRest: requests a short break.
- requestLogout: requests to go offline.
- restToWork: switches from a short break to working.

title.en: Modify online customer service representative status
